browser.taskbar.lists.frequent.enabled.description: Disables frequent sites in JumpList. Background timer reads moz_places history and sends data to Windows ICustomDestinationList API without user trigger.

browser.taskbar.lists.recent.enabled.description: Disables recent sites in JumpList. Same background history read as frequent.enabled.

browser.taskbar.lists.tasks.enabled.description: Keeps static tasks (New Tab, New Window, Private Window). No history access. Safe to retain.
